simple.meaning: עֶבְרָה (ʻebrâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “an outburst of passion.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 34 times across Genesis, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 49:7. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֶבְרָה (H5678).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עֶבְרָה (ʻebrâh) / H5678 is traced through Genesis 49:7, Job 21:30, Job 40:11, Psalms 7:7 as a generated source-based concept entry.

The desire of the righteous is only good.

He who sows wickedness reaps trouble,
For wickedness burns like a fire.
I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.
who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.

definitions.full: H5678. ebrah עֶבְרָה noun feminine overflow, arrogance, fury ; — absolute ׳ע Isa 13:9 +; construct עֶבְרַת Zeph 1:18 +; suffix עֶבְרָתִי Isa 10:6 +, etc.; plural עֲבָרוֺת Job 21:30 ; construct עַבְרוֺת Psa 7:7 ; Job 40:11 ; — 1 overflow, excess, outburst , ׳ע זָדוֺן Prov 21:24 excess of insolence ; אַמֶּ֑ךָ עַבְרוֺת Job 40:11 outbursts of thine anger . 2 arrogance , of Moab Isa 16:6 ( + גַּאֲוָה ), גַּא׃ן hence Jer 48:20 (+ id. 48:29 ). 3 overflowing rage, fury: a. of men , Gen 49:7 (poem in J), Amos 1:11 (both || אַף ), Isa 14:6 ; Prov 14:35 , עֶבְרָתוֺ שֵׁבֶט 22:8 (i. e. rod wielded by him in fury, see also Lam 3:1 below), צוֺרְרָ֑י עַבְרוֺת Psa 7:7 the outbursts of fury of my foes b. of ׳י Hosea 5:10 ; 13:11 (|| אַף ), Hab 3:8 (|| id. ), Isa 9:18 ; Lam 2:2 ; Psa 90:9 ; 90:11 ; + אַף חֲרן Isa 13:9 , || id. 13:13 ; Psa 78:49 (+ זַעַם ), 85:4 ; עֶבְרָתִי אֵשׁ Ezekiel 21:36 (|| זַעַם ), Ezek 22:31 (|| id. ), 22:21 ; 38:19 ; עֶבְרָתוֺ שֵׁבֶט Lam 3:1 (compare Prov 22:8 above); עֶבְרָתִי עַם Isa 10:6 (i.e. object of my rage), compare עֶבְרָתוֺ דּוֺר Jer 7:29 ; י עֶבְרַת ׳יוֺם Zeph 1:18 day of ׳י 's fury (coming judgment), so Ezek 7:19 (strike out Co Berthol, after ᵐ5 , as gloss from Zephaniah); so עֶבְרָה יוֺם Zeph 1:15 ; Prov 11:4 ; עֲבָרוֺת יוֺם Job 21:30 ; compare עֶבְרָה Prov 11:23 .
